description: BiBLE CC Plugin hooks — bridge Claude Code lifecycle to daemon HTTP API

hooks.command: cd ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook session-start --session-id "$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID"
cd ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook turn-user --session-id "$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID" --message "$USER_PROMPT"

cd ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook turn-tool --session-id "$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID" --tool "$CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME" --input "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" --output "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT"
cd ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} && uv run python -m bible_cc_plugin.scripts.hook session-end --session-id "$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID"
